verdict.rationale: Elicit is a SaaS research tool, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any such setting. The only related item is a community complaint about unsolicited follow-up emails, which concerns marketing email consent, not telemetry, and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
